versions.changelog:
Initial release: Extracts and summarizes key family-related notifications by person from mobile notifications.

- Groups information by relevant family members (children, spouse, parents/elders, etc.) and marks importance.
- Recognizes family roles dynamically from notification content, prioritizing user-specified "关注谁" members.
- Rates each message as 🔴 (needs action), 🟡 (FYI), or discards idle chat.
- Presents concise summaries under each person, clarifying requests, deadlines, and action items.
- Filters out marketing, expenses, travel, and irrelevant chats to deliver focused family digests.
- Supports queries for all family or specific members, adapting output accordingly.
